text:
⛽ Fuel is expected to get cheaper on Wednesday 4 November. The latest Central Energy Fund data points to petrol 95 down about 49c a litre and 93 down 33c, with diesel down about R1.58 to R1.68 a litre. Inland 95 cost a record R30.25 in October, so it would drop to roughly R29.76. These are forecasts: official prices are announced before Wednesday.

Without the fuel levy cut, it would have been the opposite. Petrol would have gone up about R1.01 to R1.17 a litre (inland 95 to roughly R31.26) and diesel up R1.32 to R1.42. The relief takes R1.50 off petrol and R3 off diesel until 1 December, then shrinks until 5 January. On a 50 litre tank, that's about R75 less than you'd otherwise pay.
